meta.thesis: There is no 'conversion tax' in either country. The cost of getting money out of China is the sum of five separate things, and only two of them are taxes. The largest single number on the page is a US reporting penalty, not a Chinese conversion charge.

layers.name: FX spread and fees
layers.nature: Unavoidable, small, and set by your bank
layers.status: Rates not published by any regulator — see the model below

layers.name: PRC tax on the source of the money
layers.nature: 20% flat on property transfer, interest, dividends, rent; 3%–45% on salary
layers.status: Verified rates; whether it applies depends on what created the balance

layers.name: US tax on foreign-currency gain
layers.nature: Only on a personal-transaction conversion gain above USD 200

layers.name: Chinese FX-violation fines
layers.nature: 0% if you stay lawful; up to 30%, or 30%–100% if serious, on the amount involved

layers.name: US information-reporting penalties
layers.nature: The dominant number: up to 50% of the account balance for a willful FBAR violation

meta.model_note: Layer 1 cannot be stated as a number honestly: SAFE publishes no retail spread and every bank's tariff differs. The formula and a calculator are given instead, with every rate left for your own bank's quote.

penalties.provision: 外汇管理条例 Art. 39 — evasion of exchange control (逃汇)
penalties.trigger: Moving domestic FX or domestic capital out of the country in breach of the rules, including by false means
penalties.penalty: Order to repatriate; fine of up to 30% of the amount evaded; where serious, 30% to 100% of the amount; criminal liability if it constitutes a crime

penalties.provision: 外汇管理条例 Art. 40 — illegal arbitrage of FX (非法套汇)
penalties.trigger: Settling RMB-denominated obligations in FX, or using false or invalid transaction documents to buy FX from a bank
penalties.penalty: Forced re-conversion; fine of up to 30% of the amount; where serious, 30% to 100%; criminal liability if it constitutes a crime

penalties.provision: 外汇管理条例 Art. 45 — private or disguised FX trading / underground banking
penalties.trigger: Buying or selling FX privately, in disguised form, as a dealer, or introducing such trades, where the amount is relatively large
penalties.penalty: Warning, confiscation of illegal gains, fine of up to 30% of the amount; where serious, 30% to 100%; criminal liability if it constitutes a crime

penalties.provision: 外汇管理条例 Art. 42 — unlawful carriage of FX across the border
penalties.trigger: Carrying FX in or out in breach of the cash rules
penalties.penalty: Warning, and a fine of up to 20% of the amount; customs action where a law or regulation so provides

penalties.provision: 外汇管理条例 Art. 48 — false documents, failure to declare
penalties.trigger: Not filing the balance-of-payments declaration, or submitting invalid or untrue documents, or breaching account/registration rules
penalties.penalty: Order to correct, warning, and for an individual a fine of up to RMB 50,000

penalties.provision: Criminal Law Art. 225(4) — illegal business operation, via 法释〔2019〕1号
penalties.trigger: Unlawful FX dealing or disguised FX dealing that disturbs financial order, at RMB 5,000,000 of turnover or RMB 100,000 of illegal gains (RMB 25,000,000 / RMB 500,000 for 'especially serious')
penalties.penalty: Prosecution as a crime; the 2019 interpretation also applies the heavier of the illegal-business and money-laundering provisions where both are made out

penalties.provision: 个人外汇管理办法 Art. 7 — splitting (分拆) to evade limits
penalties.trigger: Using splitting, or false commercial documents, to get around limit supervision or authenticity checks
penalties.penalty: The prohibition is express; the sanction is the one prescribed by the FX Regulations (N01/N02/N05)

penalties.trigger: Failing to file an FBAR when required, without willfulness
penalties.penalty: Up to USD 16,536 per violation (inflation-adjusted, penalties assessed from 17 January 2025); a reasonable-cause exception applies

penalties.trigger: Willfully failing to file, or willfully causing a violation
penalties.penalty: Up to USD 165,353, or 50% of the balance in the account at the time of the violation, whichever is greater; the reasonable-cause defence is unavailable

penalties.trigger: Not filing Form 8938 when the threshold is met
penalties.flag: The penalty provision exists; the exact escalating amount was not confirmed from an official source in this pass. Left blank.

penalties.trigger: Electing the streamlined procedures while living in the US
penalties.penalty: 5% of the highest aggregate balance of the unreported assets, in place of information-return and FBAR penalties

penalties.trigger: Electing the foreign procedures while meeting the non-residency test
penalties.penalty: No miscellaneous offshore penalty, and no failure-to-file, accuracy-related, information-return or FBAR penalties absent fraud or willfulness

penalties.trigger: Physically moving more than USD 10,000 in or out without a FinCEN Form 105
penalties.flag: The reporting duty is verified; the specific civil and criminal penalty amounts were not confirmed from an official source in this pass. Left blank.

penalties.provision: IIT Law Art. 3(3) — flat rate on the categories that matter
penalties.trigger: Realising interest, dividends, rent, property-transfer or incidental income
penalties.penalty: 20% of the taxable amount (property transfer: proceeds less original cost and reasonable expenses)

penalties.trigger: Converting RMB where the exchange-rate gain on that transaction exceeds USD 200
penalties.penalty: The USD 200 exclusion switches off entirely, so the whole gain is in play
penalties.flag: Statute read from a non-government mirror — confirm before relying on it.

cost_model.formula: Net USD received = (CNY × rate_bank) − outbound wire fee − correspondent/intermediary deductions − receiving bank fee

components.name: Bank buying rate vs mid-market rate
components.typical_source: Chinese bank's published 现汇买入价 on the day
components.flag: No regulator publishes retail spreads; every bank's tariff differs and changes. Left blank.

components.name: Outbound telegraphic transfer fee
components.flag: Not published by any regulator. Left blank.

components.name: Correspondent / intermediary bank deduction
components.typical_source: The intermediary bank in the payment chain
components.flag: Not determinable in advance. Left blank.

components.name: Receiving bank incoming wire fee
components.typical_source: Your US bank's schedule of fees
components.flag: Set by your own bank. Left blank.

components.name: SAFE application cost (approved routes)
components.flag: No fee schedule found in the sources reviewed. Left blank.

scenarios.note: Worst-case statutory exposure as a percentage of the amount moved, by route. Percentages are from the provisions above; they are not predictions.
